propositions: Plan review must validate that every acceptance-criterion item is correctly classified as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested, with criterion-specific evidence for the classification rather than keyword-only heuristics.

Acceptance criteria marked externally verifiable must carry the exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] tag; missing or malformed tags on such criteria must produce findings directing authors to use the exact syntax.

Acceptance criteria that are codebase-verifiable must not carry the [operator-attested] tag; incorrectly tagged items must produce findings explaining that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof.

Acceptance criteria that bundle both repository proof and outside-world proof must not be silently assigned a single evidence kind; the criterion must require authors to split such criteria into independently certifiable items.
High-confidence evidence-classification mismatches must participate in normal blocking policy, while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory and records abstentions.

The frozen-corpus evaluation (A1, 115b, 8c4f, malformed tags, over-tagged code, mixed-evidence cases) must achieve 100% precision on external negatives, 100% recall on named fixtures, and ≥0.90 macro precision/recall across all samples with no regression of previously passing fixtures.
